featured_reviews.name: Viren Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ok so everyone has heard about Merwans & I guess most of the people have tried it also.So I would like to share my experience with was pretty average.No doubt the cakes are awesome and pocket friendly, but Merwans also sells secondary eatables like Puffs,Rolls,Breads,Pasteries etc.I spent about a ₹100 and could try atleast 6-7 items, yes you are right 6-7.Starting from the Mini Pizza it was ok you can have one not more than that.Cheese Puff & Vegetable Manchurian Pattice were very average.I mean for ₹12-₹15 I shouldn't expect much still it was merely a pattice without any filling.Though there are few things I liked to, one of them is Pepper Veg Mayonnaise Roll.It was something you should surely try, even the Closed Pizza is good.Coming to Minis try out their Chocolate Square & Mini Dream Chocolate Pastry.There are many more things to try but this was enough to bloat on my stomach.I dint find the place upto the hype, but yeah the place is worth a visit and if you are short with money this is where you should surely hop on to for your mid time hunger.The cakes are awesome and I am a fan of their cakes for sure.
I would like to rate the place as-
Ambience-3
Food-3.5
Service-4
Overall-3.5
Note- You'll should try to increase the filling along with little price hike which would help you increase your customers.This was my view, others may have different opinions.
